Name: Universal Artisan Goods Keep Quality
Author: Kanadeyoru
Description:
[center]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/FLxT60ck/universal-artisan-goods-keep-quality.png[/img]

[size=5]This is a very simple mod that checks every machine output in the artisan goods category and [b]copies the quality from the input item to the output[/b], which means it [b]will work with every modded machine[/b] automatically.
[/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZpjxWRXY/description-artisan.png[/img]
   [/center][center][/center][size=5][center]If a machine already [b]produces items with predefined quality[/b] (for example, the Cheese Press producing gold-quality cheese from large milk), the mod [b]increases that quality based on the input quality[/b], up to iridium.
  
[img]https://i.ibb.co/HThhLPpd/description2.png[/img]
  ﻿[/center][/size][center][size=5][b]The mod's behavior can be turned on or off individually per machine[/b], so you can pick which ones copy the input quality and which keep their default behavior. [/size][/center]

Manifest.Name: Universal Artisan Goods Keep Quality
Manifest.Description: Artisan goods keep quality, works on any machine, even modded ones!
